title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater
notes: Start Game > Instructions plays a two-minute demonstration with the keys written on screen.
A run lasts two minutes. The left soft key pauses it (continue, sound levels, retry, end run).
N-Gage Arena on the main menu is Nokia's online service, which no longer exists.

Start Game > 2 Player has Bluetooth (Host Game, Join Game) and Horse Play, which asks for two skaters on one device and was not played. Over Bluetooth the host waits, the other player's search lists the host and Continue (left soft key) joins; the host picks the game (Tag Play, Graffiti, Trick Attack, Skate Race) and the course, both pick a skater. A pause by one player pauses both.

multiplayer.menu: Start Game > 2 Player > Bluetooth > Host Game / Join Game
multiplayer.statusNote: Two players in one room: one hosts, the other joins the host its search lists; the host picks the game and the course. A Trick Attack run of two minutes ran on both screens: each one's score showed as the opponent's on the other, a pause paused both, and it ended with both scores. The host is told when the client leaves. Whether each sees the other's skater is not known; other games not tried.

controls.source: The game's own Start Game > Instructions demonstration (movement, 5, 4, 6, 7). The soft keys, menu keys and that 5 also selects in menus were seen by pressing them.

actions.up: Steer the skater; with 4, 6 or 7 it picks the trick
actions.down: Steer the skater; with 4, 6 or 7 it picks the trick
actions.left: Steer the skater; with 4, 6 or 7 it picks the trick
actions.right: Steer the skater; with 4, 6 or 7 it picks the trick
actions.5: Hold to crouch and gain speed, release to ollie; select in menus
actions.4: Flip trick in the air (with a direction)
actions.6: Grab trick in the air (with a direction)
actions.7: Grind on rails or edges (with a direction)
actions.lsk: Pause; the left option in menus (Select, Continue)
actions.rsk: The right option in menus (Go back, Continue from pause, Quit)

notes: Trick keys sit in a diamond like a console pad: S or Space is ollie (5), A flip (4), D grab (6), W grind (7), with the arrows steering. On a gamepad the four face buttons do the same and the bottom one also selects in menus.

statusNote: Runs from the logos through the menus into a Career Mode run in the Warehouse: the level is drawn in 3D, steering, ollies, grinds and bails work, and the pause menu and the end-of-run statistics come up.
